Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human histone deacetylase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Histone deacetylase 1' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
